Oh, I'm so glad you answered. I've had these awful hives all over me for the past couple days—they're on my arms, legs, my whole torso basically. And my face is all swollen, especially around my eyes and lips. I can barely sleep because they itch like crazy, even with the medicine my doctor gave me.

I think it was from this new laundry detergent I tried, but whatever caused it, it's just gotten worse. I really need something stronger to help. My doctor prescribed diphenhydramine, but I've used hydroxyzine before for something like this and it worked better, so I was hoping we could talk about switching to that instead?

Hi Patti, thanks for calling in. Just so you know, I'm an AI assistant and this call is recorded for quality.

I hear you—hives for a couple days that are getting worse, and swelling around your eyes and lips sounds really uncomfortable. Before we talk about medication changes, I need to check something important: **Are you having any trouble breathing right now, or any tightness in your throat?**

No, no—I can breathe fine, thank goodness. My throat feels okay too. It's really just the itching that's driving me crazy and the swelling in my face. I just look awful, you know? And I can't concentrate at work because I'm so uncomfortable. 

But I really do think the hydroxyzine would help more than what I'm taking now. I remember it worked better last time I had a reaction like this. Can we talk to my doctor about switching?

Got it—I'm glad your breathing and throat are clear. The swelling and itching sound really miserable, and I understand why you want to try something that worked better before.

Here's the thing: switching medications is a clinical decision that needs your doctor's review, especially since you're already on diphenhydramine. I can't make that change on my own, but I can absolutely get your request to Dr. Rodriguez right away.

Let me send him a message about wanting to try hydroxyzine instead, and he can review it and get back to you. Does that work for you?

That would be wonderful, thank you. I'm just so miserable and haven't been able to get any rest at all with this itching. 

Do you think Dr. Rodriguez could call me sometime today? I'm really worried about my face looking so puffy and I'm not sure if I should keep taking the other pills until I hear from him. I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing for these... whatever they are, the red bumpy things.
